# Brand (Cin7 Core API v2)

Group `Brand` of the Cin7 Core API reference. Base URL `https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalApi/v2/`; every request carries the `api-auth-accountid` and `api-auth-applicationkey` headers (see `../api-basics.md`). 4 actions on 1 resources, 1 field tables.

| Action | Path |
|---|---|
| [GET](#get-ref-brand) | `GET /ref/brand?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Name={Name}` |
| [POST](#post-ref-brand) | `POST /ref/brand` |
| [PUT](#put-ref-brand) | `PUT /ref/brand` |
| [DELETE](#delete-ref-brand) | `DELETE /ref/brand?ID={ID}` |


Brand CRUD operations

### Available Fields for Brand
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `ID`  | Guid           |         |          |Required for PUT, Ignored for POST operations          |
| `Name`  | String             | 50        | Yes         |Brand name       |

## Brand

Path: `/ref/brand`

<a id="get-ref-brand"></a>
### GET /ref/brand?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Name={Name}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `Name` (optional): Only return brands that start with the specific name

Response 200:

```json
{
  "Total": 1,
  "Page": 1,
  "BrandList": [
    {
      "ID": "fa528b78-d8a3-4f87-b1ac-9cea985e337d",
      "Name": "New Brand"
    }
  ]
}
```

<a id="post-ref-brand"></a>
### POST /ref/brand

Request body:

```json
{
Name : "Test new brand"
}
```

Response 200:

```json
{
  "ID": "ca585936-d523-4c40-980b-fbd0199d61fc",
  "Name": "Test new brand"
}
```

<a id="put-ref-brand"></a>
### PUT /ref/brand

Request body:

```json
{
  "ID": "ca585936-d523-4c40-980b-fbd0199d61fc",
  "Name": "Test new brand 1"
}
```

Response 200:

```json
{
  "ID": "ca585936-d523-4c40-980b-fbd0199d61fc",
  "Name": "Test new brand 1"
}
```

<a id="delete-ref-brand"></a>
### DELETE /ref/brand?ID={ID}

Parameters:
- `ID` (required, string): ID of Brand to Delete

Response 200:

```json
{
  "Success": true
}
```
